d.ko: Raise your daughter while she attends a magical academy. Choose which classes she attends, jobs she does, training she undergoes, and more in a character raising sim packed full of story and over 50 endings to reach. How she grows up to be the world's cutest princess depends on you!
d.en: Raise your daughter while she attends a magical academy. Choose which classes she attends, jobs she does, training she undergoes, and more in a character raising sim packed full of story and over 50 endings to reach. How she grows up to be the world's cutest princess depends on you!
d.zh: 你将扮演一位父亲，引导女儿在魔法国度的学园中茁壮成长。养成方式多种多样：读书学习、打工挣钱……修习剑术也是不错的出路。根据你所作出的选择，海量的故事文本可导向超过50种分支结局。来亲手养育出世界第一可爱的小公主吧！
